units.source_text: 我看护着咳嗽不止的父亲，不时望望窗外的保津川。

en.t: I nursed my father, whose coughing would not stop, and from time to time looked out the window at the Hozu River.

units.source_text: 河水里浓重的群青色，就像化学实验使用的硫酸铜。

en.t: The deep ultramarine color in the river water was like the copper sulfate used in chemistry experiments.

units.source_text: 每次列车钻出隧道就看见保津峡忽而远离铁路，忽而又意外地近在眼前，

en.t: Each time the train emerged from a tunnel, I saw Hozu Gorge first draw away from the tracks, then unexpectedly come close before my eyes,

units.source_text: 被平滑的岩石所包围，轰鸣般地转动着群青的辘轳。

en.t: surrounded by smooth rocks, turning its ultramarine winch with a roaring sound.
